column1: # SumelaOS context budgets. One row per budget, TAB-separated, LF line endings.
# Readers skip blank lines and lines that start with '#'. Every row has exactly 7 columns:
#kind
# - bytes, lines, max_line: the pinned maximum, or '-' when that column is not pinned.
#   Sizes are counted with CRLF read as LF, so a Windows checkout measures the same.
# - overridable: yes|no. 'no' means .sumela/context-budgets.local.tsv cannot change the row.
# Kinds checked by tests/test_eager_budget.py in the framework repository:
#   eager-member <path>  a file every session reads before its first answer (the eager set)
#   eager-const  <name>  bytes of command output the bootstrap adds to the eager set
#   eager-total  *       the eager set: the eager-member files as measured, plus the eager-const rows
#   file         <path>  a framework source file pinned on its own
# Every pin is a ratchet. Lower it when the file shrinks: a pin more than 2,000 B above the
# measured value fails as stale. Loosening one needs, once .sumela/VERSION moves past the
# previous tag, a (vX.Y.Z) CHANGELOG bullet that contains "eager budget". Loosening is a raised
# pin, a pin replaced by '-', a row turned overridable, or a dropped row, measured against the
# previous tag's table (or, while that tag has none, against the commit that added this file).
# The test does not check rows of other kinds.
